meta.title: feat: add support for plain TXT files
meta.body_summary: Add TXT file support with line-by-line splitting to the Lingo.dev CLI loader, enabling translation of fastlane metadata files by treating each line as a separate translatable unit with numeric keys.

perf_labels.notes: Devin added TXT loader with line-by-line splitting to solve LLM chunking; maintainer approved after thorough review and local testing.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 260 changed lines across 5 files, this is a small-to-medium addition by absolute volume. As a new file format loader with line-splitting, it fits a moderate incremental feature that merged smoothly after a single approval review.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer mathio indicated he would conduct thorough review and local testing before release, not an immediate merge.
review_details.performance_claim: Line-by-line splitting enables better chunking for large TXT files, preventing LLM token limit issues.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Adding a new file format loader with line-splitting logic within the existing CLI loader factory is well within Devin's capabilities; no technical or process barriers encountered.

detection_detail.code_reading: Mathio reviewed the loader composition and line-splitting logic, ensuring it followed established patterns.
detection_detail.manual_testing: Mathio conducted local testing as stated in his comment before release.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: Tests validate loader behavior but no before/after metrics for chunking efficiency; maintainer performed local testing.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regressions; PR merged on first approval after local testing.

core_change_summary.description: Added a new TXT loader to packages/cli/src/cli/loaders/txt.ts that splits file content by lines into numeric keys (1-indexed) using a standard loader composition (textFileLoader -> syncLoader -> unlocalizableLoader). Integrated it into the loader factory index.ts and added bucket type in formats.ts. Added comprehensive tests in index.spec.ts.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: formats.ts only added 'txt' to bucketTypes; changeset is chore.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: added txt case in loader factory and formats spec.
Added initial TXT loader treating entire file as single 'content' key with tests.
Applied Prettier formatting to fix CI.
Implemented line-by-line splitting with numeric keys and space placeholder for empty lines.
Refactored to remove space placeholder, relying on unlocalizable loader for empty line handling.
